error[ZBX-E0319]: vm.max_map_count is 65530, needs >=262144
  cause  --require-host asks for vm.max_map_count>=262144, and this host's is
         65530
  key    vm.max_map_count
  host   65530
  needed >=262144
  fix    set it on the host (a file in /etc/sysctl.d/ keeps it across boots):   sudo sysctl -w vm.max_map_count=262144
         check every setting:                                                   zbx doctor
  more   zbx explain E0319
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0319.html
